description:
Submit a batch of documents to an existing HandInLoop pilot run — the agent/API intake for a Shadow-Pilot (#257).

A pilot run groups a client's documents for a side-by-side accuracy/turnaround/savings report. Create the run in the portal (app.handinloop.com/pilots) or have a human create it, then pass its 'pilot_run_id' here; every document is stamped with it and joins the run's status board and report. All documents use the run's task type — you don't repeat it.

QUOTE FIRST (#844): without proceed: true, nothing is submitted, stored or charged, and the run is not changed. The call prices every document under the run's task type (each document_url is fetched, and the files are sent to the estimate to count their pages) and returns the quote with sent: false; a document that cannot be read is listed under refused, and the rest are still priced; show it to the person you work for, then call again with the same arguments and proceed: true to submit. A document costs credits once the free tier is used up.

ASYNC and per-document: with proceed: true, each document becomes its own extraction job (returns a job_id). One bad document (unfetchable URL, etc.) is reported as a per-item error and never fails the rest of the batch. Poll progress with handinloop_get_pilot_run.

Args:
  - pilot_run_id: the run to submit into (from the portal; must belong to your account).
  - documents: [{ document_url OR document_base64, source_ref?, file_name? }] (1..200).
      - document_url is fetched here and sent as content; source_ref is your own id/filename for the doc, used to match it to a ground-truth row for accuracy scoring — set it to the filename you used in your ground-truth CSV.
  - verification_gate (optional): { critical_fields: string[], min_confidence?: number }. Applied to the run before submitting, so every document in the batch inherits it — critical fields must be human-verified before any result comes back. Only ever makes review stricter.

  - proceed (optional): true to submit. Omitted or false returns the quote and sends nothing.

Returns, without proceed: { sent: false, pilot_run_id, task_type, quote: { pages, credits, free_documents, charged_credits, available_credits, covered, held?, spend, documents? (listed up to 25) }, refused? (up to 25), refused_count?, next_step }.
Returns, with proceed: true: { pilot_run_id, task_type, accepted, rejected, submitted: [{ source_ref?, file_name?, job_id? , status?, error? }] }

documents.description: The documents to submit (1..200); each becomes its own extraction job

document_url.description: Publicly fetchable URL of the document (PDF or image)

source_ref.description: Your own id/filename for this doc — used to match ground truth for accuracy

pilot_run_id.description: The pilot run to submit into (created in the portal; must be yours)

proceed.description: true to submit; omitted or false returns the quote, sends nothing and leaves the run as it is (#844)

verification_gate.description: Trust bar applied to the whole batch (#258): set the run's verification gate before submitting, so every document inherits it. Only ever makes review stricter — it never skips human review. Persists on the run for later documents too.

critical_fields.description: Fields that MUST be human-verified before any result is returned

min_confidence.description: A stricter per-field confidence floor; a field below it goes to a human

name: handinloop_submit_pilot_batch
title: Submit a Pilot Batch
